{"baseRefName":"main","body":"### Nonfinite regression guard at `09ee7cb0`

The independent review found no material production defect, but reproduced a P2 false pass: an entirely NaN output passed the regression. The actual test now rejects nonfinite actual or expected pixels with case/coordinate diagnostics and exit 1, including under `--expect-mismatch`. The exact 0.05 tolerance, seven native cases and old-floor controls are preserved.

Eight finite controls and 15 nonfinite rejections PASS with ASan/UBSan; three guard mutants are rejected. The same actual-test NaN stand-in passes the original code and fails the repaired test. Parent completed CMake/build and focused CTest 1/1 PASS using the existing NumPy Python. [Exact commands and limits](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/blob/09ee7cb0a48a3f9bc0301239af475134cb78cd6d/docs/post_rc0/issue259/P2_NONFINITE_VALIDATION.md). Production source is unchanged. New native CUDA, performance and scientific qualification are UNRUN; retained older native results lack complete per-run argv/input/binary/device binding and are not transferred to this head. [Current-head CI](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/actions/runs/39766184934) **PASS**: Linux CPU CTest 75/75 including RealspaceBorderValidation, known-motion/smoke controls and CUDA compile-only.

---

Fixes #259. The CUDA local warp now decides the floor and bounds/fallback branch from \`(double)ix - (double)x_fitted\`, as the CPU does. Interpolation weights and the border policy are unchanged.

**Result**
- Incidence (replay of the kernel's float arithmetic over real STAR local models, all pixels and frames): the old kernel differs from the CPU in 107 (tutorial-00), 287 (e10216-00) and 168 (e12963-05) pixel-frames in the discrete sense (interpolate vs fallback, or a different fallback pixel), ~3e-7 of pixel-frames, mostly interior pixels within the local shift of an edge. The fix removes every interpolate/fallback flip; residual differences come from the float coefficients and float \`x_fitted\`, not touched here.
- Test \`CudaRealspaceBorderBranch\` (production kernel via \`cudaRealSpaceInterpolation\`, double CPU-logic oracle): fails on the old kernel (exit 8; last-column pixel gives 0, CPU 0.5), passes on the fix. Mutants \`x_float\` / \`y_float\` each fail only their own axis; controls pass.
- CTest on \`b9440a09\`, Release, 4GPUs: CPU 74/74, CUDA 111/111, CUDA+nvCOMP 114/114.
- Product (CUDA before vs after, tutorial-00 and e10216-00, DW and noDW): 234–467 pixels change (~2e-5), identical STARs, A/A rerun 0 changes. Changes above 1e-3 of rms lie within 6 / 17 px of an edge; interior changes are rounding-level (≤1.1e-6 of rms).

**Limits**: not rerun beyond full CTest and the product runs (Tier A, known-motion, QF rows); the output difference needs sign-off per POST_FREEZE_TEST_PLAN §9.2; S1 relative-RMSE effect not separated. Evidence: \`docs/post_rc0/issue259/\`.
